title: Store candidate bundles a jsPDF branch that loads remote executable code
auth_mode: guest/member/admin; package-level failure independent of sign-in
preconditions: Inspect the primary Matrx Extend Chrome Web Store submission rejected in Google's October 12, 2026 Blue Argon email.
Inspect the emitted Store JavaScript chunk containing jsPDF 4.2.1.
reproduction: Find the bundled jsPDF PDFObject viewer branch in the Store candidate chunk.
Observe that output('pdfobjectnewwindow') creates a script element, assigns its src to the cdnjs PDFObject URL, and appends it to the document.
Run the previous Store risk gate against that emitted chunk; it checks eval/new Function/DevTools Runtime tokens but does not reject the script-src loader.
Read Google's official rejection email for primary item hnfolienncfklkgmdjjmhhegglimlamg, routing ID FZSL. It cites Manifest V3 remotely hosted code and this jsPDF chunk.
expected: Every executable path shipped in the Store package is local. The package gate rejects a remotely sourced script loader, and a new candidate passes full release and guest/non-admin acceptance before submission.
actual: Google rejected draft0.2.479 for the jsPDF PDFObject CDN script loader; authenticated primary dashboard now confirms Published0.2.205 / Draft0.2.479 Rejected / Upload enabled. No replacement submission exists.
cause: The shared @ai-matrx/print package bundled jsPDF's unused PDFObject viewer branches, while the extension Store risk gate recognized only several string-evaluation tokens and missed executable script-src loading.
severity: S1: Google rejected the Store update, preventing distribution of later fixes; the rejected code path is not known to run in normal PDF use
priority: P0: restore a policy-compliant candidate and resubmit after all release gates
source_repair: Aidream commit ebaa05766f removes the jsPDF remote-viewer loader before bundling and checks the exact upstream interval; extension commit 2bbc571a5 adds a Store gate that detects the rejected emitted loader. The print L0 job in aidream run 38216542992 succeeded and npm serves @ai-matrx/print 0.12.33. Its published ESM/CJS PDF modules have no CDN/PDFObject loader URL and throw for unavailable remote-viewer modes. Extension commit 6f18f9ec0 adopts the current 22-package graph, including print 0.12.33; 32190201a implements the chat package's required host opener. Independent source review passed, and exact-main focused acceptance 38219886831 plus full CI 38219886843 passed. No current exact-source replacement Store ZIP has been scanned, so the original package-level defect has not yet passed retest. Follow-up extension commit 8c5e70d04 closes a concrete minifier-identifier evasion: the same rejected loader escaped the scan when its script handle was renamed to $, $c or c$. A red/green four-test suite exercises the detector and actual Store gate acceptance/refusal, and fresh independent source review passed. This is gate coverage only, not proof of a clean replacement ZIP or Store acceptance. Guarded release39162306660 produced0.2.549 with all required package gates passing. Fresh independent artifact review scanned1272 emitted JavaScript files: no forbidden runtime tokens, rejected PDFObject CDN URL or detected script-src loader; bounded static integrity/quality PASS. This supersedes the older no-Store-ZIP observation. The artifact is now stale after design-system206 adoption and is not eligible for upload.
